status: research_and_mechanical_audit_complete; pretrained-model memorization and controlled recipe comparisons pending

findings: GLOWC is described as internal; the post links no public training code or detailed training hyperparameters.
Gemma4-E2B trained on hundreds of thousands of examples for one pricing/payment-transparency policy task.
Quality reported as maximum F1 with threshold sweeps where scores are available, not our nine-task accuracy or composite score.
The post does not disclose full fine-tuning versus LoRA, rank, learning rate, epochs, batch size or head/loss implementation.
Frozen EmbeddingGemma2 features and one weighted logistic-regression classifier per question; not end-to-end Gemma4 fine-tuning.
Ground-truth labels receive greater weight than sampled teacher answers.
Graduation uses minority-answer checks and confidence bounds; uncertainty/novelty route to a teacher.
Online fit_student uses ordinary KFold and standardizes before cross-validation; do not copy this directly for document/request-related financial datasets.
Compares embedding layers; uses GroupKFold when enough groups exist, with row KFold fallback.
Borrow per-capability learnability checks and baseline comparisons; preserve strict family separation and train-fold-only preprocessing in our implementation.
Matched contrasts and hard negatives distinguish observable properties from topical cues.
Teacher blind spots, new formats, rare classes, causal reasoning and long units limit learnability.
Teacher agreement and teacher-student system performance are distinct from a standalone model beating native gold.
Provides completion-only/assistant-only SFT and PEFT reference implementations.
Documentation suggests approximately1e-4 as a typical adapter learning rate; this is a comparison point, not proof that2e-5 is wrong.
Reference for a conventional classification training loop. Its illustrated architecture is not a Gemma4-specific classifier recipe.
Older, deprecated Keras Gemma tutorial, not a disclosed Airbnb/Gemma4 recipe.
Demonstrates rank4 and5e-5 learning rate and recommends task-based rank/learning-rate/epoch experiments.

native_conditional_and_checkpoint_tests.scope: Tiny random Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration configuration; native-logit parity, state-dependent learning with PEFT/checkpointing, frozen base, save/load parity and resumed gradient path. This is not a pretrained E2B memorization result.

recipe_choices_needing_controls.choice: Shared128-code LM-initialized readout, candidate-conditional CE instead of conventional full-vocabulary SFT
recipe_choices_needing_controls.needed_control: Same Gemma E2B, same data and prompt, native completion-only SFT versus current head.

recipe_choices_needing_controls.choice: LoRA rank16, backbone LR2e-5, one planned shuffled pass, selected20k examples
recipe_choices_needing_controls.needed_control: Small-data E2B memorization gate; matched2e-5/1e-4 LR runs before changing model size. Add longer learning curves only after fit is demonstrated.

recipe_choices_needing_controls.choice: Divide per-example set CE by log(number of candidates), then apply domain/task weights
recipe_choices_needing_controls.needed_control: Plain CE versus normalized CE on the same batches; inspect per-task gradient norms and train/development curves. Scaling alone does not establish causality.

recipe_choices_needing_controls.choice: One shared model and a single mean validation selection objective
recipe_choices_needing_controls.needed_control: Per-capability development acceptance criteria and specialist diagnostics to detect negative transfer. Higher mean score must not hide failed financial pair discrimination or unsafe safety tradeoffs.

recipe_choices_needing_controls.choice: Routing winner/tie classification discards regret magnitude
recipe_choices_needing_controls.needed_control: Dense outcome/utility supervision or expected-regret objective, compared with the training-selected fixed-model baseline.

recipe_choices_needing_controls.choice: Native correct/counterfactual pairs grouped across splits but shuffled as separate training examples
recipe_choices_needing_controls.needed_control: Paired batches and a pair-consistency/contrastive objective, with executable financial derivations as auxiliary supervision.

sequence: Run32-64 real training-example memorization checks per weak capability, including opposite-label numerical pairs and candidate/predicate binding controls.
Compare current classifier with native completion-only SFT on the same development data.
Compare plain CE and current normalization with a bounded learning-rate comparison; keep data and model size fixed.
Use development-only acceptance criteria to select the subsequent larger data/objective experiment.
recommended_next_experiment.test_policy: Completed phase4 cases are posthoc diagnostics/regressions. No final-test-driven threshold tuning or new superiority claim without a separately sealed family-disjoint holdout.

conclusion: No dead-adapter or native-head/save-load failure found by these checks. The current recipe remains under-validated; the evidence does not isolate a single cause or establish that E2B capacity is the limiting factor.
